criteriaSources.sizeWording: Owner confirmed the stricter near100 independent human holdout target. The Stage2 roughly100 combined wording and historical provisional40 minimum remain recorded history;34 or40 alone does not pass.

fieldPrecision: Report all labeled nonnull predictions, correct facts, unsupported facts, null abstentions, omissions and label coverage; no unscored extra prediction can be silently accepted.

denominators.sourceObservation: Each actual source observation is retained and evaluated with its literal source context.
denominators.canonical: Separately human-identified distinct occurrences, milestones and resources; source aliases map to the same canonical unit only with reviewed evidence. Source observation counts and canonical occurrence counts are reported separately.
denominators.eventAndActionRecall: Report event/action detection and strict critical-field completeness separately, with absolute misses and uncertainty; the strict minimum95% applies to represented, correct event/action units, not title-only detection.
denominators.negative: Explicit human no-event/action judgment, never an empty output inferred from access/collection/processing failure.
denominators.reconciliation: Report wrong merges, distinct performances merged, retained duplicates and unresolved pairs against separately reviewed relations; no physical merging or decision propagation is implied.

humanContracts.S1_status: Confirmed representation rule: Missing event status remains unknown unless a provider contract affirmatively supports it; publishing visibility is separate.
humanContracts.S2_units: Confirmed representation rule: Per-source extraction observations and canonical occurrence/reconciliation metrics remain separate.
humanContracts.S3_dates: Confirmed representation rule: Literal source dates and event-local dates remain separate; conversions require a stated zone.
humanContracts.S4_ranges_partials: Confirmed representation rule: Multi-day ranges and partial dates/clocks remain explicit; no missing year/day/instant is invented.
humanContracts.S5_family_exposure: Confirmed representation rule: Connected organizer/opportunity/recurring/media families must stay in one split; the listed development aliases stay together.
humanContracts.S6_corpus_scope: Confirmed representation rule: Use the stricter near-100 independent human holdout target;34 or40 alone does not pass.

annotation.unknowns: Every critical field has an explicit known/unknown/not_applicable state. Null means an explicitly reviewed unknown/not-applicable value, never a missing annotation.
annotation.evidence: Known facts require exact frozen text spans or original-media hash/page/region evidence. Structural validity and quote presence do not prove semantic entailment.
annotation.additionalPartialFields: Preserve separately adjudicated source-date, event-local-date, date-range, local-clock, doors, deadline month/day/year/precision and competing source claims. The exact mapping/matcher must freeze before labels/predictions are opened.
annotation.originalSourceScope: Original text is retained alongside the frozen transformed text. Human entity/field enumeration covers original supplied source content, including fields lost by a transform. A retained-field prediction needs exact citation in its actual transformed representation; raw and transformed offsets are not interchangeable.

criticalFieldRegistry.rule: Required fields and semantic temporal/partial/range/precision/phase/status/availability/cost/eligibility/venue/building/organizer/identity/routing fields must remain critical. Noncritical prose mistakes are reported without inventing an all-facts zero-error gate.

releaseSequence: Hash and freeze exact source custody/roster, runtime candidates, media implementation, native environment/limits, source-only transform, canonical matcher, scorer, protocol and selected prompts/config.

Bind the existing six-rule owner confirmation record to the freeze without asking again, then obtain the separate independent human whole-family/exposure review. Unknown/contaminated exposure or missing future annotations still blocks assignment and gold access.

Independent human directly labels all source observations, canonical units, explicit unknowns, negatives and relations, without AI factual proposals or candidate outputs. A curator validates structure/integrity without disclosing answers to runtime engineers.
Generate every frozen candidate prediction from source only, seal its digest, and claim the exclusive source-cohort scoring receipt before any scoring process reads gold.
Run one frozen holdout comparison. Retain every failed attempt. No tuning/relabeling/gate lowering after results; further candidate development needs a new independently sourced holdout.

candidates.proposedSelected: native-v5 deterministic extraction with native-media-v2 and source-only-text-v3; no model inference or prompt is required

unchangedBoundaries: No old scorer, label or gate is changed by this protocol or six-rule confirmation. New source-backed development projections must preserve old artifacts and disclose representation changes separately from runtime improvements.
No automatic calendar addition, Meta repair, paid API/upgrade, new Auth user or later-stage work.
True social carousel/image/video access is unproven and cannot be replaced by a PDF coverage claim.
A scored threshold does not alone establish Stage2 acceptance or waive carried Stage1 gates.

representationRuleConfirmation.scope: Six source-representation rules only. No future holdout grouping/exposure/annotation, label rewrite, prediction or Stage2 acceptance approval.

coverageGates.purpose: Prevent vacuous extraction/reconciliation passes; these are source-backed human strata, never labels inferred from empty predictions. No old evaluation gate is changed.

canonicalComparison.projection: Actual source predictions are scored against exhaustive source observations first. Canonical correct-unit recall separately requires one complete correctly matched source candidate to represent the human canonical unit; partial candidates are never blended. Canonical date uses an explicit event/action-local date when emitted or a valid instant plus a stated named/fixed zone. No offset alone invents campus-local date. Without that information the canonical date abstains; date-only facts retain their explicit literal date.
canonicalComparison.fieldAccounting: Every actual nonnull source prediction is human labeled and scored. Canonical comparison uses the human canonical field scope only, rather than relabeling all source-specific claims as new canonical runtime claims. Canonical disagreements/misses are separate diagnostics and correct-unit recall; source-field quality gates remain on actual source outputs.
canonicalComparison.reconciliation: Duplicate membership is supplied by human canonical associations. Distinct-unit relations are explicitly human reviewed. Duplicate/conflicting unordered relation labels and same-occurrence aliases split across canonical IDs are invalid. Human unresolved truth with an unresolved proposal is reported as correct uncertainty abstention; unresolved predictions on resolved truth and invented resolutions still fail. The frozen production adapter proposes positive same-occurrence suggestions only. A human-reviewed negative pair with no positive suggestion is a keep-separate outcome, not a runtime claim of semantic different. Missing positive duplicate suggestions remain retained duplicates/misses. Expected blocked challenges are reported separately and never counted as semantic negatives.
